nonblocking_robustness_observation.observed: OverflowError: date value out of range
nonblocking_robustness_observation.cause: UTC conversion in _time can overflow; check/main do not normalize OverflowError to the ordinary refusal response
nonblocking_robustness_observation.impact: Malformed registry produces a traceback rather than structured refusal; execution stays disabled. No credential, order, source or account mutation occurs.
nonblocking_robustness_observation.proposed_fix: Normalize datetime conversion OverflowError to ValueError with an artificial fixture; owner discretion, not a century-run blocker.
